demo.banner: This is an example map of a made-up person.
empty.title: Your map is empty
empty.text: Write a thought, a goal, a worry or a rule you live by. The map will place it in a sphere of your life and show what it connects to.
hint: Drag to turn · zoom in to focus on the sphere in front of you
think.title: New thought
think.sub: Write it the way you would say it. The AI places it on your map as a draft: you confirm it later.
think.placeholder: For example: I want to spend more evenings with my kids, but work keeps me late…

settings.ollama.missing: Ollama is not running. Install it from ollama.com, then run: ollama pull qwen2.5:7b
settings.data.note: Your map is a single file on this computer. A backup is made on every save.

timeline.label: Map as of a date
panel.draftNote: The AI suggested this. Confirm it, fix it or remove it in “Review drafts”.
panel.howto: How it grows. Press “+ Thought” and write anything: an idea, a story, a rule, an argument with yourself. It lands in the right sphere with its links. Updated {updated}.
review.removeNote: The point and its links will disappear from the map.
conflict.title: Contradiction
conflict.manualQ: How do you reconcile these two yourself? Your words become the resolution.
ai.failed: The AI could not answer. Try again.
ai.unreachable: Cannot reach the AI. Is Ollama running? Check Settings.
ai.not_configured: The AI is not set up yet. Open Settings.
ai.auth: The API key was not accepted. Check Settings.
ai.rate_limited: The AI is busy. Wait a minute and try again.
ai.refused: The AI declined to answer this.
ai.bad_answer: The AI answered in a form the map cannot read. Try again or pick a larger model.
intro.title: Getting to know you
intro.done: Done. Look at your globe — and press “Review drafts” to confirm what the AI placed.
intro.q1: Who are you and what do you do with your days?
intro.q2: Who are the people closest to you right now?
intro.q3: Where does your money come from, and what about work worries you?
intro.q4: What are you building or learning for yourself?
intro.q5: What are you best at, and how do you like to do it?
intro.q6: What do you believe in? Which rules do you never break?
intro.q7: What do you want to have achieved a year from now?
intro.q8: What pulls you in two directions at once right now?
